content.short: Bushi is an advanced decentralized protocol designed for seamless web3 games within the Web3 ecosystem on Sui.
content.description: Competitive third-person shooter game on Sui. Built organically for the Web3 ecosystem, Bushi provides an essential suite of services focused heavily on web3 games. By operating on Sui, it allows users to experience fast execution times while maintaining strong cryptographic security. The protocol is designed to be highly interoperable, aiming to become a cornerstone of the Decentralized Games sector. Through continuous innovation, Bushi contributes to the broader vision of a decentralized, permissionless digital economy.
